name: Kisharsány (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kisharsány (a shield of red and white with a bunch of grapes, with yellow and white mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed KISHARSÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisharsány arms with mantling and scroll
